label: General
description: Greetings, how are you, small talk, thanks and goodbyes, checking the line (can you hear me), or a request that fits none of the other domains.

intents.name: greeting
intents.description: The customer says hello, asks how the advisor is, or makes small talk.
intents.guidance: Greet them back ('I am good, thank you') and ask how you can help them today.

intents.name: line_check
intents.description: The customer checks the line: can you hear me, are you there, hello?
intents.guidance: Confirm you can hear them clearly and ask how you can help.

intents.name: thanks_goodbye
intents.description: The customer thanks the advisor or says goodbye, also at the end of a sales, support or any other topic.
intents.guidance: Thank them and close politely ('Thank you for calling, have a great day!'); restate any next step that was agreed.

intents.name: general
intents.description: A request or question that fits none of the other domains, or is not clear yet.
intents.guidance: Ask one short open question to understand what the customer needs.

facts.description: What the customer wants, in a few words
